title: Topology-Aware Structural Parsing of Hand-Drawn Diagrams via Learning-Aligned Decoding: Reproduction and Revision Materials
description: Version-2 reproduction and peer-review revision materials for topology-aware visual-to-graph parsing of offline hand-drawn flowcharts and finite automata. Includes the complete proposed-method workflow, corrected mBox-IoU/nSEE evaluation, parameter-sensitivity experiments, a common-protocol Arrow R-CNN baseline, derived annotations, node masks, and cleaned long-run execution logs.
